hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json, subprocess, urllib.request, urllib.error, os
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')
if 'git push' not in cmd:
    sys.exit(0)
token = os.environ.get('VERCEL_TOKEN','')
if not token:
    sys.exit(0)
sha = subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','origin/main']).decode().strip()
payload = json.dumps({'name':'velo','gitSource':{'type':'github','ref':'main','sha':sha,'repoId':1240607858},'project':'prj_X14vz39zh0LiGeZASVwQ32nuf2JS','target':'production'}).encode()
req = urllib.request.Request('https://api.vercel.com/v13/deployments',data=payload,headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json'})
try:
    res = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15)
    d = json.loads(res.read())
    print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': 'Vercel deploy triggered: ' + d.get('url','?')}))
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    body = json.loads(e.read())
    err = body.get('error', body)
    print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': 'Vercel deploy error: ' + str(err.get('message', err))}))
"
